title: EVRI Starter Pack by Dip Devices
description:
EVRI by Dip Devices is a multi-functional consumption solution

The EVRI vape features a powerful 900 mAh battery that connects magnetically to continuously evolving attachments

Use a 510 cartridge or pull out the vapor tip attachment for consumption of concentrates directly from a container

Easy to use controls, 3 temperature settings, USB charging

Features:
Magnetic, universal battery
Multi-functional consumption
Innovative, replaceable Vapor Tip Atomizer
Ceramic tip with instant heat nichrome coil center
510 Compatible
3 heat settings
Compact, versatile design
Micro-USB rechargeable battery

For optimal performance and flavor, replace vape attachments every 6-8 weeks
